Title: Azure Cognitive Service for Language now generally available

Body.Content:
The unified Language service consolidates capabilities previously available in Text Analytics, QnA Maker and Language Understanding into a unified service, while also introducing the new features in preview: custom named entity recognition, custom text classification, and language studio.

Read the announcement blog.
